name: Treadmill
description: Motorised running belt with adjustable speed and incline. Used for warm-ups, steady-state cardio and interval work.

name: Rowing machine
description: Full-body cardio machine driven by a leg-then-arm pull. Low impact, so it suits knee-friendly conditioning.

name: Squat rack
description: Uprights with adjustable J-hooks and safety arms for squats, presses and rack pulls.

name: Weight bench
description: Flat or adjustable bench used for pressing, rows and supported dumbbell work.

name: Cable machine
description: Adjustable pulleys with a selectorised stack. Constant tension through the full range, easy to scale.

name: Leg press
description: Seated or angled sled that loads the quads and glutes with the back supported.

name: Lat pulldown
description: Overhead cable station for vertical pulling — the main lat builder when pull-ups are still out of reach.

name: Barbell
description: Olympic bar plus plates. The heaviest-loading tool in the room and the base of most strength programmes.

name: Dumbbells
description: Independent loading per side, which exposes and fixes left-right imbalances.

name: Kettlebell
description: Offset-handle weight for swings, cleans and carries — strength and conditioning in one implement.

name: Elliptical trainer
description: Low-impact full-body cardio: gliding stride with moving handles.

name: Exercise bike
description: Stationary upright bike with adjustable resistance.

name: Recumbent bike
description: Reclined stationary bike with back support — the gentlest cardio option.

name: Stair climber
description: Rotating staircase or step pedals — climbing cardio for legs and glutes.

name: Air bike
description: Fan-resistance bike with moving handles; effort sets the resistance.

name: Ski erg
description: Standing pull-down ergometer that mimics double-pole skiing.

name: Smith machine
description: Barbell fixed to vertical rails with hooks — guided squats and presses.

name: Hack squat machine
description: Angled sled with shoulder pads for guided squats.

name: Leg extension machine
description: Seated machine that isolates the quadriceps by extending the knees.

name: Leg curl machine
description: Seated or lying machine that isolates the hamstrings by curling the knees.

name: Hip abductor / adductor machine
description: Seated machine working the outer or inner thigh against pads.

name: Glute kickback machine
description: Standing or kneeling machine for pressing one leg back against resistance.

name: Calf raise machine
description: Standing or seated machine loading heel raises for the calves.

name: Chest press machine
description: Seated press with handles — chest, front delts and triceps on a guided path.

name: Pec deck / fly machine
description: Seated fly machine bringing the arms together in front of the chest; many double as rear-delt flys.

name: Shoulder press machine
description: Seated overhead press with handles — delts and triceps on a guided path.

name: Seated row machine
description: Seated row — cable or lever — pulling handles to the torso for the mid-back.

name: T-bar row
description: Chest-supported or landmine lever row for the mid-back.

name: Assisted pull-up machine
description: Counterweighted platform that assists pull-ups and dips.

name: Pull-up bar
description: Fixed bar for pull-ups and hanging work.

name: Dip station
description: Parallel bars for dips and leg raises.

name: Preacher curl bench
description: Angled arm pad that isolates the biceps during curls.

name: Biceps curl machine
description: Seated machine curl with pads — guided biceps isolation.

name: Triceps extension machine
description: Seated machine press-down or extension isolating the triceps.

name: Ab crunch machine
description: Seated crunch against resistance with feet anchored.

name: Rotary torso machine
description: Seated twist against resistance for the obliques.

name: Back extension bench
description: 45-degree or horizontal bench for extending the lower back and glutes.

name: Captain's chair
description: Upright frame with forearm pads for hanging leg raises.

name: Bench (flat / adjustable)
description: Flat or incline-adjustable bench for dumbbell and bodyweight work.

name: EZ curl bar
description: Cambered bar that eases wrist position for curls and extensions.

name: Weight plates
description: Plates for loading bars and machines; usable alone for raises and carries.

name: Resistance bands
description: Elastic bands of graded resistance for assistance, warm-ups and isolation.

name: Suspension trainer (TRX)
description: Suspended straps for bodyweight rows, presses and core work.

name: Medicine ball
description: Weighted ball for throws, slams and core work.

name: Battle ropes
description: Heavy ropes anchored to a point — waves and slams for conditioning.

name: Plyo box
description: Sturdy box for jumps, step-ups and elevated work.

name: Punching bag
description: Heavy bag for striking work and conditioning.

name: Foam roller
description: Firm roller for self-myofascial release and mobility work.

name: Stability ball
description: Inflatable ball used as an unstable bench for core, hip and back work.

name: Skipping rope
description: Rope for skipping intervals, warm-ups and conditioning.

name: Ab wheel
description: Wheel with two handles for rollouts that load the whole trunk.

name: Parallettes
description: Low parallel bars for push-ups, L-sits and handstand work at deeper range.
